description: The English reads 'Sections 5-7 and Proposition 10.5 use no asymptotic input'; the Spanish rephrases as 'las Secciones 5-7 son efectivas y no dependen de una hipotesis externa de coloreo', dropping the Proposition 10.5 mention. 10.5 occurrences: EN 10, ES 9.
reproduction: python 20_EVIDENCE/G3_BILINGUAL/scripts/v14_bilingual_deep.py, then compare Section 2.4 in both manuscripts
impact: Editorial. Both languages state Proposition 10.5's independence from Theorems 2.1 and 2.3 in Section 11.3, so no information is unavailable to a Spanish reader. Divergence in a remark, not a statement.

description: Theorem 2.2, the list-edge-colouring input to Lemma 7.1, is proved self-contained in Appendix D. Appendix D was not audited.
reproduction: read Appendix D and check the proof of the maximum-degree case
impact: None on correctness: the statement is the maximum-degree case of Galvin's theorem, published and classical, and the auditor verified that the hypothesis Lemma 7.1 needs (|L(e)| >= Delta(B)) is exactly Galvin's. What is unverified is only the self-containedness claim.
required_correction: Have a reviewer check Appendix D before release if self-containedness is to be asserted.
